comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop; PR-1906 performs an insulin-pen safety shot and then dials a 12-unit dose.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses a hex driver and thin-nut wrench with coordinated countertorque; PR-1906 requires cap removal, repeated dose-knob regrasping, visual unit correction, axial injection-force control, and safe needle orientation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained 90° opening through three cycles; PR-1906 requires a completed 2-unit safety shot with the needle up and a five-second hold, then a displayed 12-unit setting, safe tray placement, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Dose dialing and priming a medical pen are not equivalent to coupled screw-and-locknut calibration or functional retention testing; the record supplies numeric outcome and safety criteria.
